name: extraction_date
description: Date the institution directory was extracted from the FDIC API
observations: The directory is a current-state snapshot: one row per institution, carrying its latest known attributes rather than a history of them

name: cert
description: FDIC certificate number identifying the institution
observations: Primary key. Stable across name changes and the key used by financials

name: name
description: Legal name of the institution

name: rssd_id
description: Federal Reserve RSSD identifier
observations: Used to join to Federal Reserve and FFIEC sources

name: uninum
description: FDIC unique number for the institution

name: lei
description: Legal Entity Identifier

name: occ_charter_number
description: Charter number assigned by the OCC

name: ots_docket_number
description: Docket number assigned by the former OTS

name: previous_name
description: Most recent previous name of the institution
observations: The FDIC publishes up to ten previous names; only the most recent is kept

name: holding_company_rssd_id
description: RSSD identifier of the regulatory top holding company

name: holding_company_name
description: Name of the regulatory top holding company

name: holding_company_city
description: City of the regulatory top holding company

name: holding_company_state
description: State abbreviation of the regulatory top holding company

name: holding_company_type
description: Type of bank holding company

name: parent_cert
description: FDIC certificate number of the bank that directly owns this one

name: ultimate_cert
description: FDIC certificate number the institution ultimately maps to

name: successor_cert
description: FDIC certificate number the institution became after a merger or conversion

name: institution_class
description: Charter and supervisory class of the institution

name: class_code
description: Numeric subcategory of the institution class

name: chartering_agency
description: Agency that granted the institution's charter

name: primary_regulator
description: Primary federal regulator

name: secondary_regulator
description: Secondary regulator

name: is_state_chartered
description: Whether the institution holds a state charter

name: is_federally_chartered
description: Whether the institution holds a federal charter

name: specialization_group
description: Asset concentration group the institution falls into

name: ownership_type
description: Whether the institution is stock-owned or mutually owned

name: is_subchapter_s
description: Whether the institution is a Subchapter S corporation

name: is_community_bank
description: Whether the institution meets the FDIC community bank definition

name: minority_status
description: Minority depository institution status

name: trust_powers
description: Trust powers granted to the institution

name: is_agricultural_lender
description: Whether the institution is classified as an agricultural lender

name: is_credit_card_institution
description: Whether the institution is classified as a credit card institution

name: is_insured_foreign_branch
description: Whether the institution is an insured office of a foreign bank

name: files_call_report_31
description: Whether the institution files the FFIEC 031 Call Report

name: is_fdic_insured
description: Whether the institution is insured by the FDIC

name: primary_insurance_fund
description: Deposit insurance fund the institution belongs to

name: insurance_date
description: Date deposit insurance took effect

name: insurance_end_date
description: Date deposit insurance ended

name: is_insured_commercial_bank
description: Whether the institution is an insured commercial bank

name: is_insured_savings_institution
description: Whether the institution is an insured savings institution

name: is_active
description: Whether the institution was operating at the extraction date

name: established_date
description: Date the institution began operating

name: end_date
description: Date the institution ceased to exist as a separate entity

name: last_structure_change_date
description: Effective date of the most recent structure change

name: last_structure_change_process_date
description: Date the most recent structure change was processed

name: structure_change_code
description: Code of the most recent structure change
observations: The FDIC records up to fifteen change codes; the first is kept

name: is_in_conservatorship
description: Whether the institution is in conservatorship

name: is_de_novo
description: Whether the institution is newly chartered

name: last_update_date
description: Date the FDIC last updated the record

name: address
description: Street address of the main office

name: city
description: City of the main office

name: county
description: County of the main office

name: state_abbreviation
description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the main office

name: state_name
description: State name of the main office

name: county_id
description: FIPS state and county code of the main office

name: zip_code
description: ZIP code of the main office

name: latitude
description: Latitude of the main office

name: longitude
description: Longitude of the main office

name: cbsa_id
description: Core Based Statistical Area code of the main office
observations: Delineation vintage follows the FDIC extract, not the reference year

name: cbsa_name
description: Core Based Statistical Area name of the main office

name: csa_id
description: Combined Statistical Area code of the main office

name: csa_name
description: Combined Statistical Area name of the main office

name: fdic_region
description: FDIC geographic region

name: fdic_supervisory_region
description: FDIC supervisory region

name: federal_reserve_district
description: Federal Reserve district the institution belongs to

name: occ_district
description: OCC district the institution belongs to

name: website
description: Primary internet address of the institution

name: financial_report_date
description: Quarter end the financial snapshot columns refer to

name: total_assets
description: Total assets
observations: Reported by the FDIC in thousands of dollars and multiplied by 1,000 here, so the value is in whole dollars

name: total_deposits
description: Total deposits
observations: Reported by the FDIC in thousands of dollars and multiplied by 1,000 here, so the value is in whole dollars

description: Deposits held in domestic offices
observations: Reported by the FDIC in thousands of dollars and multiplied by 1,000 here, so the value is in whole dollars

name: equity_capital
description: Total equity capital
observations: Reported by the FDIC in thousands of dollars and multiplied by 1,000 here, so the value is in whole dollars

name: net_income
description: Net income for the year to date
observations: Reported by the FDIC in thousands of dollars and multiplied by 1,000 here, so the value is in whole dollars

name: return_on_equity
description: Net income as a percent of average equity

description: Number of domestic offices
